layout.body:
Hi Team,
Blundin University hosted a career fair yesterday. I was able to speak to several promising candidates for summer internships with our company. See their attached resumes. I’d like everyone to give me their feedback no later than Friday.
Thanks,
Ryan

options.A: He took a class at a university.
options.C: He was interviewed by a manager.

questions.analysis: What did Ryan do yesterday? 原文依据： Blundin University hosted a career fair yesterday. I was able to speak to several promising candidates for summer internships with our company. 翻译： 布伦丁大学昨天举办了一场招聘会。我得以与几位有潜力的公司暑期实习候选人进行了交流。 选项分析： (A)He took a class at a university. 他在一所大学上了一节课 → 错误 (B)He attended a job fair. 他参加了一场招聘会 → 正确 (C)He was interviewed by a manager. 他接受了一位经理的面试 → 错误 (D) He hired some summer interns. 他雇佣了一些暑期实习生 → 错误

questions.stem: What does Ryan ask his team to do?

options.A: Share their opinions of some job candidates

questions.analysis: What does Ryan ask his team to do? 原文依据： I’d like everyone to give me their feedback no later than Friday. 翻译： 我希望每个人在周五之前给我他们的反馈。 选项分析： (A) Share their opinions of some job candidates 分享他们对一些求职者的看法 → 正确 (B) Review a summer internship program 审核暑期实习项目 → 错误 (C) Update their résumés by Friday 周五前更新他们的简历 → 错误 (D) Introduce themselves to new interns 向新实习生介绍自己 → 错误
